title: 紐約第二大道地鐵一期~Second Avenue Subway Phase 1
focus: 深層都市地鐵建設沉陷與垂直交通~Deep urban subway construction settlement and vertical circulation
summary: 以紐約第二大道地鐵一期為背景，建立密集街廓下方新站與既有線銜接的教學剖面。課程把測量、灌漿、施工時間窗口及乘客垂直交通結合，要求分開施工變形控制和營運期人流驗證，並保留不確定度。~Use Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 to construct a teaching section with new stations beneath dense city blocks and a connection to an existing line. Combine surveying, grouting, possession windows and vertical passenger movement. Keep construction-movement control distinct from operational passenger-flow validation, and retain uncertainty rather than treating one instrument reading as a complete statement about building or station performance.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 residual=5 mm；單元 2 得 gradient=0.6 mm/m；單元 3 得 grout_volume=2.3 m^3。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 dx 的擾動測試，結果改為 5.185557 mm；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以紐約第二大道地鐵一期為背景，建立密集街廓下方新站與既有線銜接的教學剖面。課程把測量、灌漿、施工時間窗口及乘客垂直交通結合，要求分開施工變形控制和營運期人流驗證，並保留不確定度。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives residual=5 mm; unit 2 gives gradient=0.6 mm/m; unit 3 gives grout_volume=2.3 m^3. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing dx in the first unit changes its result to 5.185557 mm. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 to construct a teaching section with new stations beneath dense city blocks and a connection to an existing line. Combine surveying, grouting, possession windows and vertical passenger movement. Keep construction-movement control distinct from operational passenger-flow validation, and retain uncertainty rather than treating one instrument reading as a complete statement about building or station performance. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2007 年：第二大道地鐵一期進入隧道建設階段；2017 年：第二大道地鐵一期於元旦開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以紐約第二大道地鐵一期為背景，建立密集街廓下方新站與既有線銜接的教學剖面。課程把測量、灌漿、施工時間窗口及乘客垂直交通結合，要求分開施工變形控制和營運期人流驗證，並保留不確定度。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 entered its tunnel construction phase; 2017: Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 opened to passengers on New Year’s Day. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 to construct a teaching section with new stations beneath dense city blocks and a connection to an existing line. Combine surveying, grouting, possession windows and vertical passenger movement. Keep construction-movement control distinct from operational passenger-flow validation, and retain uncertainty rather than treating one instrument reading as a complete statement about building or station performance. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 控制網與獨立量測殘差~Survey control and independent residuals
units.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差~Survey control and independent residuals
units.mechanism: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。共同基點錯誤會同時影響兩套結果，控制網需要閉合檢查及外部基準才能發現系統偏差。 兩座標差的歐氏長度表示平面殘差大小，不是隨機標準差。先把兩套座標轉到相同基準和單位，再檢查各方向偏差；共同平移可能讓相對殘差很小但絕對位置仍錯。 對街區水準測量做閉合檢核並以穩定外部基準控制漂移。~The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. A shared control-point error affects both results. Network closure and an external datum are needed to reveal systematic bias that agreement alone can conceal. The Euclidean length of two coordinate differences measures planar residual, not random standard deviation. Transform both coordinate sets to one datum and unit before inspecting directional differences. Common translation can leave a small relative residual while absolute position remains wrong. Check closure in block-level levelling and control drift against a stable external datum.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm。敏感度：dx 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0033 m，其餘固定，結果為 5.185557 mm。模型邊界：平面兩分量殘差；不含座標轉換協方差和垂直誤差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.003 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5 mm. Sensitivity: dx, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0033 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5.185557 mm. Model boundary: Planar two-component residual; transformation covariance and vertical error are excluded.
units.verify: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。 以反向觀測、閉合路線和外部基準交叉檢核，分開報告平面殘差與可疑共同偏差。~Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias. Cross-check reversed observations, closed loops and external references, reporting planar residual separately from suspected shared bias.
units.failure: 同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 閉合良好仍可能全部同向漂移，須使用外部穩定基準。~One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. Good closure can coexist with common drift; an external stable reference remains necessary.
units.misconception: 兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確~Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy.
units.practice: 加入一個共同平移偏差，檢查兩儀器殘差與外部基準差異，提出能辨識系統誤差的控制網配置。 再以本單元 dx 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a shared translation bias, compare inter-instrument residual with error to an external datum, and propose a control network that can reveal systematic error. Also recalculate residual for the alternative dx value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 將建築兩端高差與中間沉陷槽分開，檢查測點密度。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Separate end-to-end building difference from an intermediate trough and inspect point spacing.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.0132 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.66 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.012 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.6 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.0132 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.66 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 注漿量與空隙體積~Grout volume and void account
units.title: 注漿量與空隙體積~Grout volume and void account
units.mechanism: 填充空隙所需漿量先由幾何空隙體積估算，再考慮損失與材料體積變化。注入量大不代表填充完整，因為漿液可能沿裂縫流失；壓力、流量與返漿紀錄必須互相對照。 此算例把空隙視為長乘寬乘均勻厚度的薄層，再乘假定餘量。它不是完整圓環幾何；若用於環隙局部展開，須說明薄層近似，且不能由注入總量推論填充均勻。 用局部薄層幾何估算漿量，另外記錄超灌與回流來源。~Required grout begins with geometric void volume and allowances for loss and volume change. A large injected volume does not prove complete filling because grout can escape through cracks. Pressure, flow and returns must be interpreted together to distinguish filling from loss. This example treats a void as length times width times uniform thickness with an assumed allowance. It is not full annular geometry. A locally unwrapped annulus requires an explicit thin-layer approximation, and total injection does not establish uniform filling. Estimate grout volume from local thin-layer geometry and separately record excess injection and returns.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=20 m; width=2.5 m; gap=0.04 m; allowance=1.15 1；計算：grout_volume=length*width*gap*allowance=2.3 m^3。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 0.044 m，其餘固定，結果為 2.53 m^3。模型邊界：均勻幾何間隙與假設損失係數；不指定注漿壓力或現地工法。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=20 m; width=2.5 m; gap=0.04 m; allowance=1.15 1; calculation: grout_volume=length*width*gap*allowance=2.3 m^3. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.044 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2.53 m^3. Model boundary: Uniform geometric gap and assumed loss allowance; no injection pressure or field procedure is specified.
units.verify: 核對批次體積、流量計及返漿量，將注入壓力與時間曲線同步，完成後以獨立檢測確認空隙分布。 校對泵送流量計與漿液批次密度，分開累計注入、回流及廢棄量，核對薄層幾何尺寸。~Reconcile batch volume, flow meter and returns, synchronise injection pressure over time, and verify void distribution afterward using an independent inspection method. Calibrate pump flow and batch density, separately total injection, return and waste volumes, and verify the thin-layer dimensions.
units.failure: 漏失會讓注入體積增加而空隙仍未填滿，局部封堵又會使壓力快速上升；僅憑達到預算漿量不能驗收。 達到預算漿量不等於填滿空隙，須查回流和漏失。~Loss can increase injected volume while leaving a void unfilled, and local blockage can raise pressure rapidly; reaching the budgeted volume is not acceptance evidence. Reaching the budgeted grout volume does not prove void filling; inspect returns and losses.
units.misconception: 注入漿量超過幾何空隙體積就能證明沒有殘留空洞~Injecting more than the geometric void volume proves that no void remains.
units.practice: 比較正常填充與沿裂縫漏失兩組流量壓力紀錄，做體積收支並提出能辨識兩者的獨立檢測。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 grout_volume，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare flow-pressure records for normal filling and crack leakage, build a volume balance, and propose an independent inspection that distinguishes the two. Also recalculate grout_volume for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量~Possession window and achievable work
units.mechanism: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把接續工程窗口分成隔離、施工、測試與還路的串聯任務。~A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Split a connection-work possession into isolation, work, testing and handback tasks.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=560 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 49.5 min，其餘固定，結果為 542 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=560 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.5 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 542 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded.
units.verify: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。~Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available.
units.failure: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。~Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time.
units.misconception: 施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量~The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
units.practice: 增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 垂直動線有效輸送率~Vertical circulation throughput
units.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率~Vertical circulation throughput
units.mechanism: 電扶梯的理論輸送率可由速度、梯級間距及每級人數估算，實際值還受入口遲疑、行李和站立習慣限制。多台設備不一定能線性相加，因為共用入口或出口可能先形成瓶頸。 階梯間距與速度決定理論階梯通過率，每階占用率則把機械運動轉成載客量。旅客猶豫、行李及出口壅塞會降低實際通過率，不能以理論值直接證明疏散能力。 比較深層站電扶梯和樓梯的服務量及移動時間。~Escalator theoretical throughput follows speed, step pitch and occupants per step. Hesitation, luggage and standing habits limit actual use. Several escalators do not necessarily add linearly when a shared entrance or exit becomes the earlier bottleneck. Step pitch and speed determine theoretical step passage, while occupancy per step converts mechanical motion into passenger flow. Hesitation, luggage and blocked exits reduce delivery, so the theoretical rate cannot directly demonstrate evacuation capacity. Compare escalator and stair throughput and travel time at a deep station.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step；計算：throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 0.55 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 5940 persons/hour。模型邊界：穩定速度和平均梯級占用；不含出入口匯流與無障礙替代路徑。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step; calculation: throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.55 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5940 persons/hour. Model boundary: Steady speed and mean step occupancy; entrance merging and accessible alternative routes are excluded.
units.verify: 逐時段計數入口和出口，記錄空梯級比例與行李比例，並在共用平台量隊列長度，避免把額定值當現場值。 核對階梯間距與帶速，以入口及出口計數比較乘客流量，另記停頓和空階比例。~Count entrance and exit flow by interval, record empty-step and luggage fractions, and measure the shared-landing queue rather than substituting rated throughput. Verify step pitch and belt speed, compare entry and exit passenger counts, and separately record stoppages and empty-step proportions.
units.failure: 出口暫停會造成回堵並影響整段動線；一台設備停機時，另一台的入口可能無法吸收全部轉移人流。 出口堵塞時提高帶速可能加劇累積，需先檢查出口容量。~A pause at the exit causes spillback through the circulation path; when one escalator is unavailable, the other entrance may not accept all diverted passengers. Increasing belt speed can worsen accumulation at a blocked outlet; inspect outlet capacity first.
units.misconception: 兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍~Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator.
units.practice: 比較一台停機與出口縮窄兩種情境，畫出瓶頸位置，提出電梯與樓梯的替代動線並記錄不同旅客所需時間。 再以本單元 speed 的對照值重算 throughput，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare one failed escalator with a narrowed exit, map the bottleneck, and propose lift and stair alternatives while recording journey times for different passenger needs. Also recalculate throughput for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.mechanism: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 建立車站一般換氣量，清楚區別火災煙流分析。~A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Estimate normal station ventilation while clearly separating fire-smoke analysis.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=276.3102 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 27.5 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 251.1911 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=276.3102 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.5 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 251.1911 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded.
units.verify: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。~Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.
units.failure: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。~Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources.
units.misconception: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降~A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
units.practice: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.mechanism: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 把月台候車、行走和設備占用劃成不同有效面積。~Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Divide platform waiting, movement and equipment occupation into distinct usable areas.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 463至 463 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.322857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 463, to 463 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.322857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.
units.verify: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。~Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.
units.failure: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。~A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.
units.misconception: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞~Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
units.practice: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.title: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 以入口短時降雨估算排水量，檢查泵浦停止時的積水。~A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Estimate entrance runoff during a short storm and examine accumulation with the pump stopped.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.306 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.2e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3366 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.306 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.2e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3366 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.
units.verify: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。~Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.
units.failure: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。~Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.
units.misconception: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位~A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
units.practice: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 為新線接入既有線列出不可同時授權的進路。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. List routes that cannot be authorised simultaneously where the new line joins the existing railway.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 聲能相加與分貝~Sound-energy addition and decibels
units.title: 聲能相加與分貝~Sound-energy addition and decibels
units.mechanism: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 將施工和營運聲源分開，以聲能方式計算合成量級。~Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Separate construction and operating sources and combine their acoustic energy levels.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=73 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=73.97323 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 76 dB，其餘固定，結果為 76.51497 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=73 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=73.97323 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 76 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 76.51497 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded.
units.verify: 同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。 以聲級校正器檢查儀器前後漂移，記錄頻率加權和平均時間，再測背景聲單獨量級。~Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows. Check instrument drift with a sound calibrator before and after measurement, record frequency weighting and averaging time, and measure background separately.
units.failure: 未扣除背景可能高估列車貢獻，錯用算術平均則低估高噪事件；屏障缺口還可能讓局部接收點明顯偏高。 若背景聲未扣除，不能把全部合成量歸因於列車。~Unremoved background can overstate train contribution, while arithmetic averaging understates loud events; barrier gaps can also produce local receiver hot spots. Without separate background measurement, the complete combined level cannot be attributed to the train.
units.misconception: 兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝~Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels.
units.practice: 比較相同聲級與相差十分貝的兩聲源合成，列出背景扣除的適用條件，並解釋聲壓幅與聲能的對數係數差異。 再以本單元 L1 的對照值重算 combined，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Combine equal-level sources and sources ten decibels apart, list the conditions for background subtraction, and explain the different logarithmic factors for pressure amplitude and energy. Also recalculate combined for the alternative L1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

facts: 已查證背景：2007 年，第二大道地鐵一期進入隧道建設階段。~Verified background: 2007, Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 entered its tunnel construction phase.

教學假設，單元 3：gap=0.04 m，計算 grout_volume=2.3 m^3；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: gap=0.04 m, calculated grout_volume=2.3 m^3; not measured performance.
